correctness.rationale: The affine reduction from any parallelogram to a square preserves independent uniform side parameters. Direct shoelace computation gives T=[1+(U-W)(V-Z)]/2; independent differences have triangular densities 1-|x|. The exact product convolution integrates to f_T(t)=-4(1+|2t-1|)log|2t-1|-8(1-|2t-1|). Integrating the density yields the stated survival function and centered moments. Independently expanding the exact survival in SymPy gives 4 eps^4/3+32 eps^5/15+16 eps^6/5+O(eps^7), confirming both stated tail coefficients. Conditioning on T>1-eps forces X,Y same sign near ±1; four endpoint deficits, scaled by 2eps, lie in the region sum_i x_i-2eps(x1+x2)(x3+x4)<1. Dominated convergence of constant density on the bounded region gives the uniform 4-simplex and five-part Dirichlet(1,1,1,1,1) slack law. Reflection swaps signs with exact 1/2 probability.
